title: recurring
description: Records stored in the GLOBAL 'recurring' table (written via putGlobal, not per-holon put). One record per recurring task; companion 'recurringlookup' entries map (holonId, questId) -> taskID.

id.description: Quest id this task is scheduled from.

holonId.description: Holon that owns the originating quest.

when.description: ISO start time (Date is stringified for Nostr serialization).
